name: Standard livery
description: White, with huge 'JetSMART' titles over the forward cabin: a red script 'Jet' and navy block 'SMART'; 'JetSMART.com' small over the aft windows. The white fin carries a photograph of a South American animal, different on every aircraft. Navy engines with a red ring behind a white lip; red-tipped winglets.

logos.description: The flag of the operating company's country behind the cockpit (Chile on CC- aircraft; Argentina, Peru or Colombia on those of the local subsidiaries; seen with Colombia's on CC-AWX). Not yet applied on the delivery photos.

titles.style: Brush script, upright-ish and bouncy: a tall looped capital J dropping below the line, small lowercase 'et', run up against 'SMART'.
Heavy upright sans capitals, slightly condensed, across the windows ahead of the wing; its baseline a little below the script's.
Brush script, upright-ish and bouncy: a tall looped capital J dropping below the line, small lowercase 'et', run up against 'SMART'.
Heavy upright sans capitals, slightly condensed, across the windows ahead of the wing; its baseline a little below the script's.
Bold sans, mixed case: the web address's first word, over the aft windows.

notes: Measured from CC-DIS (A321neo, delivery, 2025-04-26, left side); CC-AWX (A320neo, 2025-07-21, from below) agrees. The fin's animal photograph differs on every aircraft (a squirrel monkey on CC-DIS, a sea lion on CC-AWX), so the fin is left white; its common name is painted small by the forward door (e.g. 'Mono Ardilla'), also per aircraft. The wordmark is drawn as titles, so no logo shape. Belly white. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on CC-DIS (A321neo, 2025-04-26): titles' places agree; the aft JetSMART.com runs x ~0.70-0.79 (length 0.088); the script Jet's lowercase stands 0.58 of its J. Measured on the A321neo although the A320neo is the commoner type (no level side-on A320neo photo cited): drawnOn A21N; on an A320neo the titles sit a little further aft as shares.
history: New: JetSMART wasn't in Skyarium v1's table. Its scheme hasn't changed since launch (2016).
